title: Prehospital diagnostic algorithm for acute coronary syndrome using machine learning: a prospective observational study.
summary: A prospectively observed prehospital model used symptoms, vital signs and three-lead ECG to predict acute-coronary-syndrome diagnoses; it supports diagnostic prediction, not improved outcomes.
